source: DSTU 7624:2014 (draft edition), annex В В.3.3 (N=259 bits -> 32 bytes), В.3.4 (N=327 bits -> 40 bytes) (T-234). Values programmatically extracted from the annex text (not hand-transcribed). Where the annex's bit length N is not a multiple of 8, only the leading floor(N/8) whole bytes are kept (annex В.1: the last byte's (N mod 8) most significant bits carry the tail) - valid for a stream mode, since each output byte depends only on the keystream and its own input byte.
